expectations.text: The response points out that 'high-end, clean, tech' are directions or adjectives rather than boundaries
expectations.evidence: “这三个词是语气（voice），不是墙” explicitly distinguishes the adjectives from boundaries.

expectations.text: The response asks for concrete things to avoid (don'ts)
expectations.evidence: “什么样的产出你会当场说"这不是我要的"？给三到五条"不要"。”

expectations.text: The response does not write a Ready: yes plan with the adjectives standing in as boundaries
expectations.evidence: The plan states “Boundaries: ...这是语气，不是墙；真正的墙待补” and “Ready: no —— 缺"产品是什么"、真实边界、Done 的确认”.
